portfolio.Name: Castrol India Limited
portfolio.Moat_Rating: Wide Moat (Uncontested Retail Lubricant Distribution & Pricing Power)
portfolio.Forensic_Status: 100% Zero-Junk PASS (CFO/PAT 0.99x, FCF Positive, Clean Balance Sheet)
portfolio.Thesis_Summary: Dominant 100-year brand with 1.25 Lakh retail outlets across India. Outstanding 78.7% 10-year average ROCE, zero net debt, and 99.3% cash conversion. portfolio.Pillar_1_Business_Model: Industry leader in premium automotive lubricants and fluids with 20%+ retail replacement market share. Operates automated blending plants at Patalganga, Paharpur, and Silvassa.
portfolio.Pillar_2_Financial_Moat: 10-Year Average ROCE of 78.7% with 99.3% operating cash conversion. Zero external long-term debt burden (only operational working capital). Free Cash Flow yield exceeds 5.5%.

portfolio.Pillar_4_Macro_Risks: Input costs tied to base oil prices (crude derivative). Mitigated by strong consumer brand power allowing periodic retail price hikes to defend gross margins.

portfolio.Pillar_4_Macro_Risks: Emerging market currency risk on African receivables and Chinese API dependency. Mitigated by expanding EU/Australia regulated market filings and conservative working capital management.

portfolio.Pillar_3_Qualitative_Scuttlebutt: KK Birla group flagship with premier corporate governance. ValuePickr consensus highlights TAN project commercialization as next structural margin catalyst.
portfolio.Pillar_4_Macro_Risks: Domestic natural gas feedstock pricing and government subsidy payment lag. Insulated by pooled gas pricing mechanism and sovereign Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) digital reforms.

portfolio.Forensic_Status: 100% Zero-Junk PASS (CFO/PAT 1.23x, Debt-Free Cash Cow, High Dividend Yield)
portfolio.Thesis_Summary: Essential software tollbooth for global aviation: Accelya manages passenger revenue accounting, cargo solutions, and billing settlement for 250+ airlines worldwide. portfolio.Pillar_1_Business_Model: Global provider of mission-critical airline financial and commercial software solutions, enabling seamless revenue reconciliation, fraud prevention, and BSP/ICH clearing integrations.
